The famous 90-foot stone with 'strange symbols' is only known from 1800s accounts; it was never photographed and the rendering used today dates from 1949. Source: Popular Mechanics (2021), Smithsonian (1988).

Geologists Steven Aitken and Gordon Fader say the Money Pit is a natural sinkhole in soluble gypsum and limestone, with fallen trees as 'platforms' and natural flooding. Source: CBC (2020), Popular Mechanics (2021).
